response.justification: While Bogdan is a talented and accomplished software engineer with strong fundamentals in testing, agile practices, and cross-functional collaboration, there is a critical mismatch with this role's core requirements. The position explicitly demands deep C++ expertise with STL, networking, and multi-threading at an architectural level—yet his C++ experience is limited to ~6 months over 11 years ago (National Instruments, 2014-2015). More significantly, he lacks any experience in industrial automation, IEC 62443 security standards, secure development lifecycle practices, industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA), and IoT systems. His career has been primarily in web, mobile, and GIS platforms using JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js. While his software engineering fundamentals are excellent, this represents a fundamental domain and technology stack mismatch rather than a learning curve.
strengths: Exceptional software craftsmanship with proven expertise in TDD, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies across 20 years
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing demonstrated through multiple technical workshops, talks, and high-quality open-source projects
Experienced in designing event-driven, scalable systems and microservices architectures with focus on performance optimization
concerns: Critical C++ expertise gap: only 6 months of C++ experience in 2014-2015 with 11+ year absence; role requires architectural-level C++ proficiency with STL and concurrent programming
Zero experience in industrial automation domain, IEC 62443 standards, secure development lifecycle, and industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 104, OPC UA, DNP 3.0)
Career trajectory is web/full-stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React) rather than systems/embedded; holds BS not B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech as required; no MQTT or embedded IoT background
